head_commit.message:
Feed the PRs screen from prs.rs and show transcript tails in the Agents detail

LiveSource now fetches open PRs through gh on a background thread every
60 s (the first snapshot waits at most 1.5 s so one-shot frames carry
real counts), maps them to the PRs screen with the exact missing merge
preconditions, and marks rows stale with the time of the last good
fetch when gh fails. Each agent's detail pane gets the last 40 messages
of its transcript (Claude, Codex, Cursor and Grok line shapes; role:
text, sanitized, 200 chars), read from the file tail and cached by
mtime and length under a 60 ms per-snapshot budget.

Plan of record PR 7/8 wiring completion (MVP definition §3).

head_commit.message:
PR queue: open pull requests across board repositories via gh, with missing preconditions

`bf prs` lists open PRs for every GitHub repository the board knows about
(active claims and recent entries, plus the current repository), through
`gh pr list --json` with a 10 s timeout and no prompts, and states the
exact unmet merge preconditions per PR: failing or pending checks, the
missing `REVIEW: approve <head-sha>` comment, a non-CLEAN
mergeStateStatus, or draft. Tests use a fake `gh` shim on PATH and
fixture JSON, so CI needs no GitHub credentials.

head_commit.message:
Wire bare `bf` to live discovery and the board; stop and note from the screen

`bf` with no arguments now shows every live Claude/Codex/Cursor/Grok
session and the real board through LiveSource (src/live.rs): agents from
discovery, claims and recent entries from ~/.bf/bf.sqlite, load from
/proc/loadavg, and the generated AGENT_CHAT.md digest refreshed with a
Live-agents section every 30 s while the screen runs. `x` on Agents and
`bf stop <pid>` send TERM then KILL to the target's process group, refuse
pid 1, bf's own ancestry and bf's own group, treat zombies as gone, and
record a stop entry; `bf stop` is human-only (agents get exit 2). `n`
posts an addressed note; `x` on Board releases a claim as the operator.

Plan of record PR 7 (MVP demo): ~/.claude/plans/please-study-the-tips-snazzy-canyon.md

head_commit.message:
Board: claims, heartbeats, releases with proof, addressed notes, generated AGENT_CHAT.md

Replaces hand-edited AGENT_CHAT.md with an append-only SQLite board
(~/.bf/bf.sqlite): component-wise path overlap, idempotent re-claim,
30-minute leases extended by heartbeat, STALE on expired claims, release
with `--proof '<cmd>'` that runs the command and records exit code,
output digest, changed paths and HEAD, notes addressed to an agent/claim/PR
with an inbox (`bf board --to me`) and a trailer on every write, writer
identity from the observed process tree, and an atomically regenerated
digest with straggler import after the end marker.

workflow_runs.display_title: De-bloat non-code artifacts and make CI cached and browser-free

head_commit.message:
De-bloat non-code artifacts and make CI cached and browser-free

Removes the point-in-time evidence bundle, benchmark scripts, Playwright
journeys, BUILD_CHECKPOINT.json and docs/qualification.md (nothing in
src/, tests/ or build.rs references them). scripts/check now refuses a
Node/npm other than the CI pins (web/.nvmrc = 22.23.2, npm 10.9.8), runs
no Chromium download and no fixture demos; scripts/build-web no longer
appends CLAIM/RELEASE lines to ../AGENT_CHAT.md. The workflow gains
pinned cargo and npm caches and only runs pushes on main plus pull
requests, so a PR no longer triggers two identical runs.

Plan of record PR 2a: ~/.claude/plans/please-study-the-tips-snazzy-canyon.md
